rows.label: tlk70000077_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Thank you for that terrible-tasting
food before... No, really, that's a
compliment. A compliment.

rows.label: tlk70000077_01_msg0002
rows.name:
Thanks to you, my homesickness and
fatigue are completely gone. My
maintenance work is going great now.

rows.label: tlk70000077_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Oh, yeah... Talking of curing
things, how are you managing
to heal up during fights?

rows.label: tlk70000077_01_msg0004
rows.name:
A healer's role is to keep a constant
eye on allies so their health doesn't
run out during battle.

rows.label: tlk70000077_01_msg0005
rows.name:
Pay particular attention to the health
of whoever is drawing the enemy's
hostility.

rows.label: tlk70000077_01_msg0006
rows.name:
The moment that person goes down, the
whole party could collapse.

rows.label: tlk70000077_01_msg0007
rows.name:
The other day, I served Superbian food
to fellow mechanics. The hardiest ones
started dropping one after another...

rows.label: tlk70000077_01_msg0008
rows.name:
We had some trouble filling
our work quota for that day,
I can tell you! Hahaha!
